title: A two-stage classification of linear generalized Stone–Wales paths in Goldberg–Coxeter images of the dodecahedron: paper and verification packet
description:
Paper (v8.1) and verification packet (A3 1.0.5). For the Goldberg–Coxeter images GC(k,l)[C20] of the dodecahedron, the existence of a literal linear generalized Stone–Wales path, in the sense of Bille, Buchstaber and Spodarev, is classified by an explicit two-stage residue criterion. The classification is proved in Lean 4 using only the standard axioms and was checked with Comparator against an independently written statement. The proofs have not had human peer review, and novelty is not settled; the packet records exactly what was checked.

The research was carried out with AI systems (OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude Code); the author directed the work and is responsible for it.
